name: How long does a typical woodwork repair take?

mainEntity.name: How long does a typical woodwork repair take?

acceptedAnswer.text: The duration of a woodwork repair project varies significantly based on the extent and complexity of the damage. Minor repairs, like small dents or scratches, might be completed within a few hours. More extensive projects, such as repairing significant rot or structural damage to a deck or large custom piece, could take several days or even weeks. During our initial assessment, Maine Results will provide a clear estimate of the project timeline tailored to your specific repair needs, allowing you to plan accordingly.
acceptedAnswer.description: The duration depends on damage extent and complexity. Minor repairs might be hours, while extensive projects could take days or weeks. We provide a timeline during assessment.
